title: Thao Tran – Market Making Illiquid, Non-Fungible Assets (S7E14)

reader_summary.headline: A word of mouth is how this podcast grows.
reader_summary.overview: A word of mouth is how this podcast grows. Today, I'm talking with Tao Tran, co-founding partner at Vamient Capital. This episode was born from a question I had watching the NFT marketplace. How do you make markets in illiquid, non-fungible assets?

key_points.text: Clearly, people were doing it, and I wanted to know how.
key_points.evidence_quote: Clearly, people were doing it, and I wanted to know how.

key_points.text: how it differed from traditional marketmaking.
key_points.evidence_quote: how it differed from traditional marketmaking.

key_points.text: Several people recommended I speak with Tao, and she was kind enough to oblige.
key_points.evidence_quote: Several people recommended I speak with Tao, and she was kind enough to oblige, despite NFT marketmaking being just a small component of what she does.

key_points.text: In this conversation, she walks me through how the NFT marketplace has evolved, how she thinks about managing inventory risk.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this conversation, she walks me through how the NFT marketplace has evolved, how she thinks about managing inventory risk, key features that impact spreads, and how platform evolutions changed order book strategies.
